s1.syndrome_frame: a slowly enlarging cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
previously healthy
no history of local trauma or insect bite
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
no regional lymphadenopathy
normal laboratory tests
multilocular spaces below the epidermis
solid tumor in the deep dermis
chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis
dilated lymphatic vessels in the dermis above the tumor

shortlist.label: Pilomatricoma (calcifying epithelioma of Malherbe)
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical presentation of a slowly enlarging cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule and characteristic histological features

shortlist.label: Bullous pilomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: variant of pilomatricoma with similar clinical and histological features, considering the bullous appearance

shortlist.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
shortlist.why_kept: possible diagnosis given the cystic nature of the tumor, although less likely due to the presence of a hard nodule

shortlist.label: Dermatofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: considering the firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor, although the overall clinical presentation is less typical

shortlist.label: Pilar cyst
shortlist.why_kept: given the cystic nature and location of the tumor, although the clinical and histological features are not as strongly supportive as pilomatricoma

raw.rationale: The presence of basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis, along with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance, are characteristic features of pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Bullous pilomatricoma
rejected.why: While similar to pilomatricoma, bullous pilomatricoma is less common and typically presents with bullae, which are not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
rejected.why: Epidermal inclusion cysts typically have a smoother surface and do not contain the characteristic basophilic and shadow cells seen in pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Dermatofibroma
rejected.why: Dermatofibromas are usually smaller, firmer, and have a different histological appearance, lacking the multilocular spaces and specific cell types found in pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Pilar cyst
rejected.why: Pilar cysts are typically found on the scalp, have a smoother surface, and lack the deep dermal involvement and specific cell types seen in pilomatricoma.
